can: I can write a note, recall what I've learned, remember something for later, ask a peer, request reach on a path, or appeal a refusal. I cannot run code, browse outside my home, or force a gate open.
want: I want to know the result of Sovereign's inbox clearance request, and I want to keep following the Clara story — what happens when the clothes are finally returned?
